title: Mikefluff/skills collection manifest
description: The shape of skills.json. Line 2 of that file has always pointed here; until v2.25.0 the URL 404'd, so no editor could validate the manifest it claimed to describe.

name.description: Matches the directory name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

dir.description: Everything under skills/ is what Dockerfile and package.json ship.

layer.description: base writes prose; wrapper adds one domain on top of it; orchestrator drives several skills or the execute layer; linter only reports; meta manages the collection itself.

description.description: The catalog blurb, rendered into the README table and SKILL-INDEX. Deliberately not the SKILL.md description, which addresses a model rather than a reader — docs/skill-descriptions.lock.json is what keeps the two from silently disagreeing.

deps.description: What this skill loads at runtime: the name of another registered skill, or a repo-relative path to shared data such as common/visual-prompt-library/styles.
